title: org.json
description: The shape of the hub's org.json, and of an org preset (docs/hub/org.md, "The shape"). The file is trees of positions of seats, each addressed by id. A preset file is ONE tree in the same shape, so validate a preset against "#/$defs/tree"; the top-level oneOf accepts either a file or a tree. Every level is additionalProperties true: a key a reader does not read is ignored (named once as a warning; a key starting with _ is a note), never refused. machines, machine and active are retired: read and kept, never written or drawn. This schema holds the required keys (activeTree among them when there is more than one tree), the types and the enums. It cannot express the cross-field checks -- ids unique, a reportsTo naming a position in the same tree, no loop, exactly one root, activeTree naming a tree, a prompt that is a real role file -- which the two readers keep (Scripts/Read-OrgChart.ps1, agent/solitaire/org.py) and Tests/fixtures/org/table.json holds.

trees.description: The trees, at least one. A writer keeps at most three; a reader reads more.

activeTree.description: The id of the tree in use. Required when there is more than one tree.

tree.title: A tree (an org, or a preset)

id.description: The tree's address, unique among the file's trees; a preset's id.

title.description: What the org is called. Replaces name: a reader takes name as the title when there is no title.

name.description: An older file's title, read when there is no title. Never written.

shortDescription.description: One line: what it is and what it fits.

description.description: A few sentences: how the work flows, who owns what, what it fits.

teamSize.description: The standup room the org suggests. The Space's features.teamSize decides.

preset.description: The id of the preset the tree was started from.

activatedAt.description: The day the tree last became the org in use, YYYY-MM-DD, written by Staff. It tells an inactive org (in use before) from a draft (never in use); the state itself is derived, never stored.

positions.description: The positions, in the order siblings are drawn.

machines.description: Retired: read and kept, never written or drawn.

title.description: The office's name; the id when absent.

prompt.description: The role name: a role file's name, looked up in the hub's agentic/org/, the hub's agentic/, then the toolkit's agentic/org/.

reportsTo.description: The id of the position it reports to; absent on the one root.

defaultModel.description: Free text: the model the office is meant to have; a pool's line.

recommend.description: The model families the picker offers without a not-recommended note.

seats.description: The seats; absent or [] makes the position a pool.

roleTitle.description: This seat's own label, where it differs from the position's title.

model.description: The model sitting there: a models.json id, a family, or any text. Looked up, never parsed.

person.description: A person sitting there, in the user's own words. The owner's seat always has one.

session.description: The session's name: the address readies and messages route to.

merges.description: True on the seat that holds the merge.

space.description: The Space slug the seat serves.

machine.description: Retired: read and kept, never written or drawn.

active.description: Retired: read and kept, never written or drawn.
